claim: On sv10043 v26.40.8-7a95011 a line whose labor belongs to a deleted staff member cannot be built: a staff member with recorded time cannot be deleted (screen and behind the screen)

positive_control.evidence: Same session created the staff member ZZAUTOTEST Del Tech (Settings > Staff > New Staff Member > Save & Close), clocked 0.02 h on S10043-17594 line 2 as that person, and deactivated the record (is_active=false read back) — so create/edit/deactivate all work with this method (hc32-hc36 logs).

tried_through_the_screen.evidence: Settings > Staff > ZZAUTOTEST Del Tech edit icon: the Delete button is disabled; its tooltip reads "This staff can't be deleted, they have tasks records history." (hc35.log).

waited_and_retried.evidence: Two screen attempts (hc34, hc35) and two behind-the-screen attempts (hc36: by user id 404 'Staff was not found', by staff id 400 'Staff is being used elsewhere.').

checked_for_navigation.evidence: The edit window stayed open; no navigation, no new tab.

precondition_read_back.evidence: Line 2 of S10043-17594 shows Labor 'ZZAUTOTEST Del Tech' and 0.02 / 1.50 hours (hc34/hc35); staff record read back active=false deletable=false (hc36).

searched_the_repo.evidence: git grep 'Deleted user' and "can't be deleted" under build/: only the regression notes (Deleted user seen after moving labor via Edit Timesheet) and this suite's cases; no recorded way to delete a staff member who has time.

asked_what_would_make_this_my_fault.evidence: Most likely mine: trying to delete before the time existed, or a stale page. Ruled out: the time was read back first, the tooltip names the reason, and the server gave the same refusal behind the screen.
